messages:
kate: Datadog PM asked for a short "golden-path" doc specifically focused on GovCloud / regulated customers. They want checklist items around endpoint selection, certs/key rotation, dashboard sanitization, and a smoke-test. Can eng/security/marketing put together a small bundle?

oliver: Eng: yes. Key tech notes: exporter must support site=dd-gov.datadoghq and avoid sending any EU/US endpoints when GovCloud is selected. Per-tenant API keys only, KMS-backed. We'll add a simple config example.

mina: Marketing: we'll need sanitized screenshots plus a one-paragraph blurb that avoids naming any customer data. Also need recommended metric names for the tile.

rishi: Security/ops: recommend weekly cert rotation for the exporter-client certs when used for GovCloud, and daily audit logs for key access. For user identifiers use HMAC with a per-tenant key and store the key in KMS. Note: HMAC reduces re-id risk but doesn't eliminate it.

frank: Legal: we can provide a public checklist and a DPA summary link. Must include: "No PII in screenshots", "Confirm customer data residency", and a note that this is operational guidance, not contractual. For GovCloud ensure we call out the gov endpoint explicitly.

kate: Oliver, can you paste the tiny OTLP snippet to include in the doc? Keep it minimal.

oliver: sure 1 minimal YAML example below:
```yaml
exporters:
  datadog:
    api_key: ${DD_API_KEY}  # per-tenant, store in KMS
    site: dd-gov.datadoghq  # choose for GovCloud customers
processors:
  sanitize:
    rules:
      - key: user.email
        action: remove
      - key: request.body
        action: remove
  hmac_user_id:
    key: ${HMAC_KMS_KEY}  # keyed HMAC via KMS
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [sanitize, hmac_user_id]
      exporters: [datadog]
```

mina: metric names we'll surface in the tile: ["redwood.request.latency_p95", "redwood.token.count", "redwood.model.fallback_rate"]. We'll export three screenshot-ready panels: latency p50/p95, tokens/sec, fallback %.

rishi: ops runbook (short): 1) Ensure exporter site=dd-gov.datadoghq and api_key in KMS. 2) Rotate HMAC key weekly. 3) Run smoke test: push 100 traces with 3 sample spans (one >2s); verify traces accepted and dashboard panels render. 4) Check audit logs for key access.

frank: legal checklist bullets to publish: ["No customer PII in screenshots","Confirm data residency and endpoint selection","Link to DPA summary","Public operational guidance only"]

dd-integ-bot: integration: upload sanitized dashboard JSON and request smoke test when staging traffic is available.

kate: owners/ETAs: Oliver 1 exporter snippet + PR (Tue), Rishi 1 ops runbook + KMS rotation note (Wed), Mina 1 screenshots + metric list (Wed), Frank 1 legal checklist + DPA link (Wed). We'll hand to datadog-partners@ after legal sign-off.

oliver: pushed branch partners/dd-gov-playbook with exporter sanitizer and test fixture.

dd-integ-bot: smoke-test queued (partner=redwood, env=staging).

dd-integ-bot: smoke-test passed (2026-03-27T15:12:46Z) 1 100 traces accepted, dashboard renders OK.

kate: thanks team. I'll draft the public-facing checklist copy and ping for final review. If anything else to add, drop it here. :thumbsup:
